text: They briefly reported all that they had been commanded to Peter and those with him. After this, Jesus himself sent out through them, from the east to the west, the sacred and imperishable proclamation of eternal salvation. Amen.
note: Shorter ending (NA28 [[ ]], TAGNT type O; in the app's Greek, not in the WEB). English by Greek Maestro 2026-11-27 against «Πάντα δὲ τὰ παρηγγελμένα … σωτηρίας. [ἀμήν.]»; the app's Greek ends …σωτηρίας ἀμήν, so 'Amen.' is kept

text: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.
note: NA28 8:8 is ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν, no τῷ δακτύλῳ: WEB "with his finger" trimmed (Greek Maestro 2026-11-27)
